reader.requirement: END-READ ends the scope of the indexed-file READ statement (formats 1 and 2, with AT END / NOT AT END or INVALID KEY / NOT INVALID KEY, or none) per §1985:IV.6.4.3: a READ with END-READ is a delimited scope statement usable inside IF, inside a PERFORM ... END-PERFORM, and inside another READ's INVALID KEY phrase, each END-READ closing the most recently begun unterminated READ; an END-READ with no READ is refused, and 2002 lock phrases on READ are refused at 85.
